mutants.description: Red_LED1 patterns swapped: a latched trip blinks and outstanding strikes show solid, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: With the latch set, Red_LED1 follows the blink square wave instead of staying solid. With strikes outstanding and no latch, Red_LED1 stays solid instead of blinking.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary takes the latch term from the Red_LED1 indicator instead of the live latch_state/latch_assert inputs
mutants.reason: In the clean-run window (strikes outstanding, running, no live fault), Green_LED goes dark each time the strike blink is high, though it should stay solid. On a latch trip Green also goes dark one clock late.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is masked during soft-start, as if an input sag during start-up inrush were expected and not worth showing
mutants.reason: If uvlo_state is high while ss_active is high, Red_LED3 stays dark instead of lighting. It lights only once soft-start ends.

mutants.description: Power-good LED latches on once regulation is first reached and is cleared only by reset, instead of following the comparator
mutants.reason: After pgood has been high once, a later fall of pgood (a hiccup, latch or shutdown) leaves pgood_LED lit until rst_n.

mutants.description: Blink is made a one-clock tick at each half-period terminal count instead of a square wave toggled there
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding and there is no latch, Red_LED1 gives one clock-wide pulse every half-period instead of a 50% duty square wave, so it looks almost dark.

mutants.description: Strike blink is shown only while the converter is switching, so Red_LED1 goes dark during the hiccup off-time though strikes are outstanding
mutants.reason: In hiccup, strike_level is non-zero while ss_active and run_active are both low. Red_LED1 then stays dark instead of blinking until the retry soft-start begins.
